notes.name: rc_bandpass.txt
notes.text:
Passive RC band-pass:
- Created rc_bandpass.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch directly in /home/cua/kicad_project/ and exported rc_bandpass.net using KiCad format. Step 47 clean title and saved status confirm schematic persistence; export dialog closed without visible error.
- Device:R R1=10k shunt after C1, R2=10k series to output. Device:C C1=15nF series input, C2=1.5nF shunt output. Connector_Generic:Conn_01x02 J1/J2 pin 1 signal, pin 2 plain GND. Four ground symbols, no signal labels or power flags.
- Enable pin numbers in properties (227,742). One r rotates default R/C so pin 1 left; duplicated horizontal C rotated then y gives pin 1 upward. Connector x mirrors horizontally.
- ERC had only one undriven GND power-input error, zero warnings. Delete All Markers (440,722), Close (605,722).
- Export: File (10,58), hover Export (83,192), Netlist (198,219), Export (650,774), verify rc_bandpass.net under cua/kicad_project, Save (757,913), Ctrl+S clears export-induced star.
- No rejected actions or significant placement difficulties. Initial library setup required waiting and accepting footprint library defaults before chooser became ready.
- Prior simple value edits and empty netlist scored 1.00; buck 0.67; astable and LED timer 0.00. Those scores support GUI save/export recipes but do not prove full-build reference agreement. This task is visually verified against intent, with no independent parsed netlist comparison or score yet.
